rules: Complete identical edge domain and complete parent permutations.
One randomNumber(0,1), strict less than 0.5 chooses the first parent.
First addition followed by alternating switch-or-keep pairs of attempts; duplicate skips also consume control attempts.
Ordered child contains every edge once; no implicit fitness or rank copy.
One randomNumber(0,1) per position; only strict p less than pmutation swaps.
No overlap, empty overlap or incomplete list draws randomNumber(0,N-0.1) and truncates to a position.
Complete overlap draws randomNumber(0,count-0.0001), selects an ordered edge and queries the temporary dp_indices.
Arbitrary swaps do not update dp_indices. Complete overlap swaps update only two items.
NTRY=0: no extra draw or used-edge filtering, while unreachable source call sites remain unmodified.
Finite double fitness, larger is better.
Strict absolute difference less than FLT_EPSILON is a tie; earlier population position wins.
